verdict.rationale: Attio is an AI CRM with its own agents, so it could plausibly act as an MCP client and the axis applies. The evidence only shows the opposite direction: Attio's own official MCP server, which lets external AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT manage Attio. Nothing shows Attio connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools. App SDK server functions that call third-party APIs are a developer building block, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
